statements.sql: select * from `users` where `type` = 1 and `email_verified_at` <> 'null' and (((exists (select * from `roles` inner join `role_user` on `roles`.`id` = `role_user`.`role_id` where `users`.`id` = `role_user`.`user_id` and `role_user`.`user_type` = 'App\User' and `name` = 'administrator'))) or (exists (select * from `roles` inner join `role_user` on `roles`.`id` = `role_user`.`role_id` where `users`.`id` = `role_user`.`user_id` and `role_user`.`user_type` = 'App\User' and `name` = 'subadministrator')))

select `roles`.*, `role_user`.`user_id` as `pivot_user_id`, `role_user`.`role_id` as `pivot_role_id`, `role_user`.`user_type` as `pivot_user_type` from `roles` inner join `role_user` on `roles`.`id` = `role_user`.`role_id` where `role_user`.`user_id` = 2 and `role_user`.`user_type` = 'App\User'

select `roles`.*, `role_user`.`user_id` as `pivot_user_id`, `role_user`.`role_id` as `pivot_role_id`, `role_user`.`user_type` as `pivot_user_type` from `roles` inner join `role_user` on `roles`.`id` = `role_user`.`role_id` where `role_user`.`user_id` = 3 and `role_user`.`user_type` = 'App\User'
